content: Asmuni n ṣṣdaqi i imqeddasen di Urcalim
Nessargeb i kenniw, aytmatneɣ, arḍa n AREBBI i immewcen i tmesmunin di Makiduniya,
maɣar umi xasen dd-ikka uqeǧeb imɣar n řmeḥnet nsen, tfeyyeḍ řefraḥet nsen, u aṭṭas n wagřa n tecrimet nsen iɛdu zzeřḍ nsen imɣaren,
minzi cehhdeɣ, aqa ɛlaḥsab jjehd nsen u ɛad sennej i jjehd nsen - řami ttexsen s wuř nsen -
aqa zawgen aneɣ s jjehd maḥend ad carcen di arḍa n tsexxart n imqeddasen.
Uca nitni war ggin min tuɣa nessitim waha, maca aqa wcin ixef nsen amezwar i Siditneɣ, xenni uřa i neccin ɛlaḥsab min ixs AREBBI,
ařami nzaweg Titus, am mammec tuɣa ibda qbeř, ḥima ad ikemmeř ɣarwem uřa d tecrimet-a n ṣṣdaqi.
Maca am mammec tfeyyḍem di marra - di l’iman, deg wawař, di tussna, di marra cḍaret, u di tewhibt n tayri nneɣ i ɣarwem iǧan - ittxeṣṣa ad tfeyyḍem ɛawed di tecrimet-a n ṣṣdaqi.
War ttumureɣ kenniw waha, maca arezzuɣ ad qeǧbeɣ tidett n tayri nwem s cḍaret n imeddukkař nwem di l’iman.
Minzi aqa tessnem arḍa n Siditneɣ Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ, belli idweř d amezřuḍ di ṭṭweɛ nwem, waxxa tuɣa-t s wagřa, ḥima kenniw ad tdewřem d twajjar s zzeřḍ nnes.
Ad kenniw weṣṣiɣ mliḥ - minzi man aya i nnfeɛ nwem - maḥend min tebdam ad tenwam deg useggʷas iɛdun, ad t teggem ɛawed.
Kemmřem řexxu s tmegga min tuɣa tenwam, kemmřem s tmegga min tuɣa kenniw tᵉmmeẓrem ad t teggem ɛlaḥsab min iǧan ɣarwem.
Maca mařa din meẓri, aqa ittwajeb ɛlaḥsab min ɣares, war iǧi ɛlaḥsab min war ɣares iǧi.
Minzi war ittřiq ḥima ad din tiři řefsaset i inneɣni u ad xawem tiři řmeḥnet,
maca ḥḍam ad tiwḍem ɣar řmizan di řweqt-a, uca ejj afeyyeḍ nwem ad iɛemmar řeɣben nsen di řweqt-a, ařami afeyyeḍ nsen di man aya ad iɛemmer řeɣben nwem, ḥima xenni ad yiři řmizan,
am mammec tura:
“Wenni issmunen aṭṭas, war d as iceṭṭ ca, d wenni tuɣa iyarrwen drus, war dayes iqqim řexṣeṣ.”
Maca aqadi i AREBBI wenni iggin cḍaret-a xawem deg wuř n Titus,
minzi iqbeř tutra nneɣ uca, am tuɣa dayes amnus xawem, iṭṭewweɛ maḥend ad ɣarwem dd-yas.
Uca nessekk-dd akides ɛawed umatneɣ wenni ɣar iǧa uweqqar di L’Injil di marra timesmunin,
wenni ittwafarzen zi ssibbet-a s jjehd zi tmesmunin maḥend ad yuyur akidneɣ ak-d tecrimet-a n ṣṣdaqi i ittwaggen s tsexxart nneɣ i uɛuǧi n AREBBI u i ucejjeɛ i neccin.
Maca nḥeṭṭa maḥend war d aneɣ iḍeǧem ḥed mařa nseyyar tacrimet-a n ṣṣdaqi ifeyyḍen,
ḥima min d aneɣ icqan ad iɛdu mliḥ, war iǧi waha qibač i AREBBI maca ɛawed zzat i iwdan.
Nessekk ɛawed akidsen umatneɣ, wenni d aneɣ isscanen řebda deg waṭṭas n tmesřayin, aqa netta ittceṭṭar, maca řexxu ittceṭṭar ktar minzi netta ittcař xawem aṭṭas.
Mařa xenni Titus d amɛacar inu d umɛawen inu jar awem, u mařa xenni aytmatneɣ nneɣni aqa aten d rrusul n tmesmunin n uɛuǧi n Lmasiḥ,
ejj xenni taqeǧebt n tayri nwem u n usemɣar nneɣ daywen zi jjihet n tmesřayin-a ad teffeɣ ɣar barra zzat i marra tmesmunin.
